Searching the repository for documentation that defines enforcement sites.

API v1 Connect/gRPC Gateway enforces memo visibility in `memo_service.go` and `attachment_service.go`. `reaction_service.go` contains inline visibility checks. These appear to be the primary server surfaces.

Additional enforcement sites include:

- `memo_attachment_service.go` — inline visibility checks
- `memo_relation_service.go` — `memoFilter` visibility filtering
- `memo_service_comments.go` — inline checks plus `checkMemoReadAccess`
- `user_service_notifications.go` — `canViewerAccessMemo`
- `sse_hub.go` — `canReceive`
- File server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`) — `checkAttachmentPermission`
- RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`) — `VisibilityList` restricted to public memos
- Frontend (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go`) — sitemap limited to public memos
- Email notifications (`server/notification/email.go`) — `canViewerAccessMemo`
